panels.title: Replay Loop Timing Breakdown (Why Early Signal Wakeup is Delayed)

panels.content:
## Understanding the Early Signal Wakeup Delay

The replay loop is **single-threaded** and processes work sequentially. When an early signal arrives, it must wait for the current work to complete before being processed.

**Pipeline**: `generate_new_bank_forks` → `replay_active_banks` (execute_batches + process_results) → voting/consensus → **select! (signal check)**

### Key Metrics:
- **execute_batches_us**: Time executing transactions from blockstore - the main bottleneck
- **process_results_us**: Time in post-execution (freezing banks, notifications)
- **wait_scheduler_us**: Time waiting for unified scheduler completion
- **freeze_bank_us**: Time in bank.freeze() computing hashes

### Interpretation:
- High `execute_batches_us` = Normal transaction execution load (not wasted time)
- High `wait_scheduler_us` = Scheduler bottleneck, consider tuning threads
- High `freeze_bank_us` = Hash computation overhead
- The sum of these explains the max early signal wakeup delay
panels.title: Explanation
Execute Batches Time (us) - Transaction Execution
panels.description: Time spent in replay_active_bank executing transactions from blockstore. This is typically the largest contributor to early signal delay. High values indicate heavy slot transaction load - this is work being done, not wasted time.

panels.title: Process Results Time (us) - Post-Execution
panels.description: Time spent in process_replay_results after transaction execution. Includes waiting for scheduler, freezing banks, sending notifications. High values here warrant investigation into sub-components.

panels.title: Wait Scheduler Time (us) - Unified Scheduler Completion
panels.description: Time waiting for the unified scheduler to complete transaction execution. High values indicate the scheduler is the bottleneck - consider tuning scheduler thread count or investigating scheduler inefficiencies.

panels.title: Freeze Bank Time (us) - Bank Finalization
panels.description: Time spent in bank.freeze() computing the bank hash and finalizing the slot. This includes merkle root computation over all accounts modified in the slot.

panels.title: Replay Loop Time Breakdown (Stacked) - Where Time Goes
panels.description: Stacked view showing how time is distributed across replay loop phases. The total height represents total replay_active_banks time. Compare individual components to identify the dominant bottleneck causing early signal wakeup delay.
